Class GUIView

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsoft.mesos.client.view.gui.GUIView
All Implemented Interfaces:
ClientView
public class GUIView extends Object implements ClientView
JavaFX implementation of the ClientView contract.

This class is the controller behind gui.fxml. The FXML file describes the static structure of the window: the top bar, the login page, the lobby list page, the lobby command page, the game page, and the final-result page. Fields annotated with FXML are injected by FXMLLoader by matching their names with the fx:id attributes in the FXML file. Methods annotated with FXML are event handlers referenced from the FXML file through attributes such as onAction="#handleLogin".

GUIView now keeps only the controller responsibilities: FXML field ownership, FXML event handlers, the ClientView callbacks, the JavaFX lifecycle, page navigation and server-call dispatch. The bulk of the rendering work is delegated to three collaborators:

  • LobbyRenderer for the lobby pages and the current-lobby snapshot.
  • BoardRenderer for the game board, the player rows, the tribe cards, the final ranking and the loading placeholders.
  • GameTurnController for the local turn state, the legal-action rules and the optimistic card-pick counters.

All JavaFX nodes must be read or modified on the JavaFX Application Thread. Button handlers are already executed on that thread, but server updates can arrive from TCP or RMI networking threads. For this reason every public ClientView update method delegates UI work through runOnFx(Runnable).
